exposure: maternal characteristics (urban residence, CD4+ T cell count, education level, occupation, maternal anaemia, maternal age)
outcome: maternal to child transmission of HIV
cohort: All pregnant and parturient women attending Gadarif Maternity Hospital, Sudan from January 2009 to December 2013.
finding: More HIV-infected women had maternal anaemia and gave preterm birth, but none of their newborn babies were HIV infected until 96 weeks of age.
